description.silhouette: Heavy hostile void-tech machine on a 3 x 3 cell footprint: a central resonance core, radial coils or emitter pylons and one armored energy outlet pointing toward the portal entry outside the asset.
description.colors: Matte blackened gunmetal, charcoal iron and dull oxidised bronze with honest chips, soot and rust bleed; a single motivated violet accent (VOID_PALETTE) in the core, coil tips and outlet only.
description.anatomy: Strict orthographic plan view, no ground or baked shadow. Intact, damaged and rubble states share one fixed 96 px canvas and centered pivot; emission is authored only on the violet energy parts so a congruent emissive pass can drive charging versus open.
